sample_title: H111 wt aeobic
experiment_title: GSM1181833: H111 wt aeobic; Burkholderia cenocepacia H111; RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Cells were flash frozen on dry ice, and RNA was harvested using hot phenol protocol (Pessi et al. 2007) and DNA was removed. First-strand cDNA synthesis was performed using an oligo(dT)-adapter primer and the M-MLV reverse transcriptase. The resulting cDNA was PCR-amplified to about 20-30 ng/μl using a high fidelity DNA polymerase.
